title: version
description: e-designer says which build answered: its version and every contract version it answers, so a reader picks a contract both speak before asking anything else (ADR-S06).

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Version, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Which build answered and what it speaks.

version.description: The version of the build that answered, so a person sees which release runs.

contract.description: The contract version this answer is in.

contracts.description: Every contract version the app answers, so a reader picks one it also speaks (ADR-S03, ADR-S06).
